flashcard_questions.a: Large-scale development decided by national governments and big external organisations.
Money invested in a country by transnational corporations building factories or offices.

flashcard_questions.q: Why do critics argue that international aid can hold a country back?
flashcard_questions.a: It creates dependency instead of the country developing its own economy.

flashcard_questions.q: What price protection does Fairtrade give farmers in lower-income countries?
flashcard_questions.a: A guaranteed minimum price, even when global prices fall.
Simple tools and machines that are affordable to buy and cheap to maintain.

flashcard_questions.q: Which Kenyan cooking device is the lesson's example of intermediate technology?
How does the Upesi stove improve health in Kenyan homes?
flashcard_questions.a: It cuts indoor air pollution, lowering respiratory infections in women and children.

flashcard_questions.q: Which group of rich countries agreed in 2005 to cancel poor countries' debts?
How much debt was cancelled for Zambia?
What did Zambia fund with the money saved by debt cancellation?
flashcard_questions.a: A free healthcare scheme for millions of people in rural areas.
Small loans for people who cannot borrow from traditional banks.

flashcard_questions.q: What share of Kenya's GNI comes from tourism?
How many people does tourism employ in Kenya?
What is economic leakage in Kenyan tourism?
flashcard_questions.a: Tourist money going to foreign tour operators rather than staying in Kenya.

flashcard_questions.q: Which 2020 event caused the sharpest fall in Kenya's tourism revenue?

notes: 15 cards: 5 term-to-definition (top-down, FDI, intermediate technology, microfinance, economic leakage), 5 case-study-to-fact with one figure each (Zambia $4 billion, Kenya 10% GNI, Kenya 500,000 jobs, G8 2005, COVID-19 2020), 2 strategy-to-example (Upesi stove, Fairtrade minimum price), 3 cause-to-consequence (aid dependency, Upesi and respiratory health, Zambia healthcare). Dropped the bilateral/multilateral/NGO aid trio as a definition set that interferes, and the FINCA sewing-machine detail.
